comment: Frame 096, printed p. 80: the problem of frame 095 concluded: the estate seven hundred and fifty-five, two fifths three hundred and two; less the share, eighty-two, two hundred and twenty; less its quarter and fifth, ninety-nine, a hundred and twenty-one; with three fifths of the estate, four hundred and fifty-three, five hundred and seventy-four, eighty-two to each of seven shares. Then, under «فان كانت الفريضة على حالها» in bold, the same heirs and a bequest of the share of a son less a quarter and a fifth of what remains of the two fifths after the share: from two fifths two shares are taken, the son having two portions, and what was excepted is added back; an estate and nine tenths of a fifth of an estate less two shares, continued on the next page. Below the rule two footnotes of the editors.

lines.text: وخمسين . والخمسان من ذلك ثلثمائة واثنان . ثم ارفع النصيب من ذلك وهو
اثنان وثمانون فيبقى مائتان وعشرون ثم ارفع من ذلك الربع والخمس تسعةوتسعين
سهماً فيبقى مائة وأحد وعشرون فزد عليها ثلاثة أخماس المال وهو اربعمائة وثلاثة
وخمسون فتكون خمسمائة وأربعة وسبعين بين سبعة أسهم لكل سهم اثنان وثمانون
وهو نصيب البنت وللابن ضعف ذلك {n:١} . {b:فان كانت الفريضة على حالها} وأوصى
لرجل بمثل نصيب الابن إلا ربع وخمس ما يبقى من الخمسين بعد النصيب {n:٢}
فالوصية من الخمسين ترفع من ذلك نصيبين لأن للابن سهمين فيبقى خمسا مال إلا
نصيبين وزد ما استثنى عليه وهو ربع الخمسين وخمسها إلا تسعة أعشار نصيب
فيكون خمسى مال وتسعة أعشار خمس مال إلا نصيبين وتسعة أعشار نصيب فزد
على ذلك ثلاثة أخماس المال فيكون مالا وتسعة أعشار خمس مال إلا نصيبين

observations: L05: the words فان كانت الفريضة على حالها (L05), the run-in heading of the next problem, as on frames 091 and 095, are printed in a bold face, after a full stop; وأوصى, which follows, is in the face of the text. The bold ن is printed without its dot; transcribed ن.
L01: the hundreds are printed ثلثمائة (L01), without the alif of ثلاث, as on frames 089, 092 and 095; transcribed as printed. L07: «خمسا مال», the dual, as on frame 095, L06.

Set without a word space after a non-connecting letter, and transcribed so (gaps as the nearest approach of the letter bodies, px at 400 ppi): تسعةوتسعين (L02; 5 between the ة and the conjunction و, where مائة وأحد in L03 has 23, ثلثمائة واثنان in L01 22 and اربعمائة وثلاثة in L03 23).

Where the gap lies between the distances inside a word and those between words, a word space is transcribed: وأحد وعشرون (L03; 16 between the د and the conjunction و, where the د stands 6 to 7 px from a و inside a word and 18 from the conjunction و after a space on frame 064; in doubt, the space is written); وهو اربعمائة (L03; 19 between the و and the alif, where the conjunction و stands 14 and 15 px from the alif in وأربعة, L04, and وأحد, L03; in doubt, the space is written).

After a connecting letter, whose final form marks the end of the word, a word space is transcribed where the print sets the words close: وعشرون ثم, ثم ارفع, من ذلك, ذلك الربع (L02), فتكون خمسمائة, بين سبعة (L04), ترفع من (L07), فيكون خمسى, خمس مال, مال إلا (L09).

The note marks and the full stops (gaps as the nearest approach of the ink at 400 ppi): after وخمسين, before والخمسان (L01; 28 and 25), and after واثنان, before ثم (L01; 26 and 33), the full stops stand between spaces; (١) stands 20 px after ذلك, followed by a full stop 19 px after the mark and 25 px before the bold فان (L05); (٢) stands 32 px after النصيب, at the end of L06, without a full stop.

Plain alif where a hamza might be expected, as printed: واثنان, ارفع (L01), اثنان, ارفع (L02), اربعمائة (L03), اثنان (L04), وللابن (L05), الابن (L06), للابن (L07), استثنى (L08); with hamza: وأحد, أخماس (L03), وأربعة, أسهم (L04), وأوصى (L05), لأن (L07), أعشار (L08; L09, twice; L10), أخماس (L10); below the alif: إلا (L06, L07, L08, L09, L10); on ي: ثلثمائة (L01), مائتان (L02), مائة, اربعمائة (L03), خمسمائة (L04).
With tanwīn on the final alif: سهماً (L03); without tanwīn as printed: خمسا (L07), مالا (L10).
The final yā' is printed without dots: فيبقى (L02, L03, L07), the bold على, وأوصى (L05), يبقى (L06), استثنى (L08), خمسى (L09), على (L10).
The print stretches لكل (L04, between the ل and the ك) with the elongation stroke; the stroke is not transcribed.

Notes (١) and (٢) of the editors restate the two problems in modern notation. (١), on the problem of frame 095, with the daughter's share x: the bequests x and 9/20 (2/5 − x), together 11/20 x + 9/50; what remains, 41/50 − 11/20 x, equals seven shares, 7x; hence x = 82/755, the daughter 82 parts of 755 and a son twice as much; the note ends «والوصيتان هما ٨٢ ، ١٠٨ أجزاء», the bequests 82 and 108 parts. The second bequest is 99 parts, 9/20 (2/5 − 82/755) = 99/755, as the text has it (L02), and 755 − 82 − 99 = 574 = 7 × 82, while with 108 the remainder, 565, is not a multiple of seven (checked exactly). (٢), on the problem of this page, with a son's share 2x: the bequest 2x − 9/20 (2/5 − 2x), printed «= ٢٩/١٠ س − ٩/٥٩», where the constant is 9/50, as the next line of the note has it; what remains, 59/50 − 29/10 x, equals 7x; hence x = 59/495, the daughter 59 parts of 495, a son twice as much and the bequest 82 (checked exactly). Neither note is reproduced.
